sections.Profile:
"Spin Wheel" is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in March 1968. Designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Art Stenholm, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, and five kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Good Times, Original Theme, Games
